name: The Wildos: Xmas Xpress
review:
The Wildos: Xmas Xpress is a festive 4x5, 20-line train heist with multiplier wilds, the Bounty Poster feature, and free spins with sticky multiplier wilds.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 10,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.19%.

The Bounty Poster feature replaces the Wanted mechanic, and the bonus brings sticky multiplier wilds. It's the festive version of the series' train-heist sequel.
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
